title: Identify speakers
intro: Match only the people you select. A suggestion becomes a final name only after a person confirms it.
manualHint: You can always use the speaker naming control below to choose a contact or a custom label. Identification does not register voices.
conflict: The record or identification context changed. Refresh before making another decision.
accessError: This record, media or voiceprint scope is no longer available to this account.
requestError: The request could not be verified. Names are hidden until you refresh.
uncertain: The submission may have reached the server. Check its status or retry the exact same request.
noTargets: No unlabelled speaker tracks are available for identification.
candidateHint: Select people explicitly. Personal matching is limited to you; organization matching uses current members of that organization.
processing: Identification is still processing. You can confirm or reject suggestions when the whole request finishes.
speaker: Speaker track
verificationUnavailable: This suggestion cannot currently be verified. Its candidate name is hidden.
previewError: The player is not ready or playback failed. Try again after the recording loads.

result.mixed_speaker: This track may contain multiple speakers.
result.ambiguous: More than one candidate is plausible.
result.unavailable: No usable authorized voiceprints or verified audio are available.
